headline: TikTok permanently bans Musk documentary's account ahead of wider release
summary: TikTok banned an account tied to Alex Gibney's Musk documentary just ahead of its wider US release. Outlets differ on whether the banned account was the film's general social media presence or specifically its advertising account, and one report cites a political-content policy as the stated reason.
